_comment: The Blacksmith (buildings.json blacksmith): each player forges improvements for their own units, one at a time, from a village with a Blacksmith; what is forged serves all that player's villages and armies. Every trainable unit has a `line` for each stat it has (attack, defense and health only where the unit's own is above 0; speed for every unit that moves): each line has `levels` levels of `perLevel` more of that stat (added to the group's research bonuses). Level n needs a Blacksmith of level `smithyLevels`[n-1] in the village forging it. It costs the unit's own training cost x `costFactor` x n, and takes (`hours.base` + `hours.perTier` x the unit's requiresLevel) x n game hours (divided by world speed), shortened by the village's smithTime (the Blacksmith's level).

defense.name: Stouter armor
defense.description: The unit takes less of every blow.

health.name: Hardier troops
health.description: It takes more to bring one of them down.

speed.name: Better harness
speed.description: The unit marches faster; an army keeps the pace of its slowest unit.
